'''Johan Haneveer Mains And Toys LS''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Johan Haneveer]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls66.htm Mains And Toys], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010114024800/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls66.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Johan Haneveer]]
